title: Angular Service Options Schema
description: Creates a new, generic service definition in the given or default project.

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the service?

path.description: The path at which to create the service, relative to the workspace root.

flat.description: When true (the default), creates files at the top level of the project.

skipTests.description: Do not create "spec.ts" test files for the new service.

barrel.description: Flag to indicate if must be added into barrel

type.description: Append a custom type to the service's filename. For example, if you set the type to `service`, the file will be named `my-service.service.ts`.

addTypeToClassName.description: When true, the 'type' option will be appended to the generated class name. When false, only the file name will include the type.
